name: themectl
title: Themectl
description: Switch themes and wallpapers with themectl
author: nico-mayer

commands.name: set-theme
commands.title: Set Theme
commands.description: Select a theme from a list of installed themes

commands.name: random-wallpaper
commands.title: Random Wallpaper
commands.description: Set random wallpaper for current theme

commands.name: pick-wallpaper
commands.title: Pick Wallpaper
commands.description: Pick a Wallpaper for your current theme

preferences.name: themectlPath
preferences.title: Custom Themectl Executable
preferences.description: Optional path to an unmanaged themectl executable; leave blank for automatic installation
preferences.placeholder: Leave blank to use managed Themectl

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
